intro.vo: Renting in Barcelona is exhausting. Chasing agencies, refreshing portals, waiting for the callback, and finding out you were too late. In Barcelona, thirty-six percent of flats are gone within a day. Chezy is the AI rental agent that does the hard work for you: it searches, calls the agency and books the viewing.
intro.title: Chezy

brief.label: Brief
brief.callout: No form. A profile that follows her.
brief.vo: Hannah is moving to Barcelona. She tells Chezy what she wants: neighbourhoods, budget, bedrooms. No form. Her answers become a profile that follows her into every chat, so she never repeats herself.

screen.greeting: What flat are you looking for?
screen.assistant1: Welcome, Hannah. Three quick things: which neighbourhoods, your monthly budget, and how many bedrooms?
screen.user2: Gràcia or Eixample, 1,800 a month, 2 bedrooms.
screen.assistant2: Saved. Gràcia or Eixample, up to €1,800, 2 bedrooms. Anything else that matters, like commute or a gym nearby?

shortlist.label: Shortlist
shortlist.subtext: Home listings, matched to her profile
shortlist.callout: Price per m² next to the barrio average.
shortlist.vo: Chezy searches real Barcelona listings and returns the ones that match her profile, as cards, with the price per square metre next to the barrio average. It knows what she likes, and every yes or no she gives sharpens the next search.

screen.user: Find me a bright 2-bed in Gràcia under €1,800.

forensic.label: Forensic check
forensic.subtext: Sunlight and price, from the data
forensic.callout: 0% direct sunlight. 13% over the barrio average.
forensic.vo: Now the part listings don't want you to see. Chezy reads the photos and the data behind each card. The first flat says "luminoso". Its windows face an interior lightwell, one and a half metres wide. Zero percent direct sunlight, and thirteen percent over the barrio average. It gets an amber flag. The second flat faces south and sits seventeen percent under the average. It passes. The trap is visible before Hannah wastes an afternoon on it.

screen.amberSummary: 0% direct sunlight, windows onto a 1.5 m interior lightwell. 13% over the Gràcia average.
amberBullets: Ventanas a patio interior de 1.5 m
screen.greenLine: Forensic check passed: south facing, 17% under the Eixample average.

call.label: The call
call.subtext: One tap, and Chezy calls the agency in Spanish
call.callout: She doesn't have to chase anymore.
call.vo: The Eixample flat is a hundred percent match, so Hannah asks Chezy to call. This is where every renter loses the race: agencies don't answer email, and the call happens during office hours. Chezy calls the agency, names the flat, and agrees a slot. Tuesday at half past six. Hannah never had to call anyone.

screen.approvalUser: Book a viewing for the Eixample one.
screen.approvalAssistant: Calling the agency now, in Spanish. I'll say I'm an AI assistant.

transcript.es: Hola, soy el asistente de inteligencia artificial de Hannah. Llamo por el piso de dos habitaciones en Eixample.
transcript.en: Hi, I'm Hannah's AI assistant. I'm calling about the two-bedroom in Eixample.
Yes, still available. When would she like to see it?

transcript.es: ¿El martes a las seis y media?

booked.label: Booked
booked.vo: The confirmed slot lands on Hannah's calendar. Brief, shortlist, check, call, booked. No chasing, no refreshing, no being too late. Booking a visit made easy.

screen.assistant: Viewing booked: Tuesday 22 September, 18:30. Added to your calendar.

stack.label: How it works
stack.callout: The listing works for the agency. Chezy works for you.
stack.vo: Under the hood: a chat surface on Next.js and Nebius, a Postgres store of real Barcelona listings, and an agentic loop that does not stop at answers — it acts. SLNG runs the voice agent, authored with unmute. Vonage carries the call to the agency's phone. Cognition's Devin helped build it, and QualityClouds keeps it honest. The listing works for the agency. Chezy works for you.
